Kamaldeo Ram, aged about 24 years, Son of Late Narayan Ravidas, Resident of Village- Galhowar,
Ambedkar Basti, P.O.- Kharki, P.S.- Bishnugarh, District- Hazaribagh... ... Petitioner
CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH ------

For the Petitioner : M/s. Shekhar Prasad Gupta, Advocate For the State : M/s. Rakesh Ranjan,
A.P.P.
-----
02/11.12.2024 Heard the parties 2.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Markacho P.S. Case No. 47/2024 corresponding to Special POCSO Case No. 30/2024, for the offences registered under Sections 363,
366, 376(2)(n) of the I.P.C. and Section 6 r/w Section 5(l) of the POCSO Act, pending in the Court of learned A.D.J.-1- cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Koderma.
3. The petitioner is alleged to have enticed away 17 years old daughter of the informant with the intention to marry her.
4. Statement of the victim was recorded under Section 164 of the Cr. P.C. in which she has stated that she has left her lawful guardianship according to her own wish and has married the petitioner.
5. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the informant has vehemently opposed the prayer for Kamaldeo Ram vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...

6. This appears to be the case of adolescent love affairs between the parties.
7. In view of the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned A.D.J.-1-cum- Special Judge (POCSO), Koderma in connection with Markacho P.S. Case No.
47/2024 corresponding to Special POCSO Case No. 30/2024.
